author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
HALO: Reach comes to life with Noble Team and a brand new Reach scenario set using a huge double sided map. Let's dive in, check out the stats and game modes and the rules for the Man Cannon launch pads!

Thanks to Mantic for the complimentary copy of the box to review.
